captions.detailed: A compact, black camera kit zoom lens featuring a retractable barrel assembly. It consists of a stationary outer barrel with mounting tabs at the rear, a middle zoom ring with ribbed grips and white focal markings, and a telescoping inner barrel that houses a blue-tinted front lens element. The inner barrel telescopes prismatically along the optical axis, while the zoom ring rotates on a continuous revolute joint around the outer body.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact camera kit zoom lens. The model should include a stationary outer barrel with a rear mount, a rotatable ribbed zoom ring, and an inner telescoping barrel with a blue front glass element. Ensure proper joint definitions for the rotating zoom ring and the telescoping inner barrel.
captions.factory: Construct the main lens body using concentric cylinder primitives for the outer barrel, zoom ring, and inner barrel. Create the ribbed grip texture on the zoom ring by patterning small rectangular boxes or thin cylinders radially. Use boolean subtraction to hollow out the barrels, and add colored cylinder elements for the blue front lens and metallic rear mount. Define a revolute joint for the rotating zoom ring, and a prismatic joint along the central Z-axis for the telescoping inner barrel.
